quests.name: Protecting What Was Lost
quests.plugin: BetalillesHammerfellQuestBundle.esp (no later plugin edits this quest in these records; its people are edited by The Gray Cowl - Betalilles LoreRim Patch.esp)
quests.canDoWhy: A girl named Azita challenges you to win back her grandfather Azzin's sealed sword.

starts.where: around Azzin's Hideout in the Alik'r Desert (Hammerfell)
starts.how: Talk to Azita; she dares you to break the seal on Azzin's sword by fighting three dragons for their stones.

quests.firstStep: Activate the pillar in front of the magical barrier in Azzin's Hideout

takesYou.why: start the trials at the pillar, and later use the three stones on the fire, frost and shock pillars
kill the Fire, Frost and Shock Dragons and take a stone from each body

objectives: Interact with the pillar to begin the trials
Kill the Fire Dragon
Pick up the Fire Stone from the Fire Dragon's body
Kill the Frost Dragon
Pick up the Frost Stone from the Frost Dragon's body
Kill the Shock Dragon
Pick up the Shock Stone from the Shock Dragon's body
Use the Fire Stone on the pillar
Use the Frost Stone on the pillar
Use the Shock Stone on the pillar
Pick up the Boneshaver Replica

rewards.when: at the end, once the seal is broken

people.name: Azita
people.role: Azzin's granddaughter; waits around Azzin's Hideout until you take her challenge, then moves to the Common House

people.name: Fire Dragon, Frost Dragon, Shock Dragon
people.role: the three trial dragons, out in the Alik'r Desert

unsure.why: The conditions on Azita's opening line aren't in these files, so anything she requires first (for example the mod's Blades story) isn't known.
The three dragons are placed in the open Alik'r Desert; exactly where isn't in these files. Azzin's Hideout has no place record either.
Azita's package before the quest keeps her near Azzin's Hideout; once it starts she sleeps and sandboxes at the Common House.

evidence: giver INFO 000B74 on Azita 001855, stage below 10
Azita packages HABLAzitaQuestStart (Azzin's Hideout, while quest below stage 10), HABLAzitaSleep/Sandbox (Common House, stage 10+)
aliases FireDragon 000AC7, FrostDragon 000AC9, ShockDragon 000AC8 placed in Alik'r Desert worldspace

needs.what: Finish A Lost Temple in Hammerfell

starts.where: in the Wind Scour Temple, the Blades' temple in the Alik'r Desert (Hammerfell)
starts.how: Talk to Za'kir; he asks you to find two worthy followers to join the Blades in Hammerfell.

quests.firstStep: Find a follower and ask them to join the Blades in Hammerfell

takesYou.why: ask two followers to join the Blades

choices.leadsTo: those two join the Blades at the Wind Scour Temple

objectives: Find a follower and ask them to join the Blades in Hammerfell
Find a second follower to ask them to join the Blades in Hammerfell
Head to the Wind Scour Temple and talk to Za'kir

closes: the two followers you recruit join the Blades for the Wind Scour Temple

people.name: Loremaster Za'kir
people.role: Blades loremaster who gives and closes the quest
